name: ZYLtech Engineering, LLC
summary: Houston, Texas filament manufacturer founded in 2015, extruding in-house with a stated target of roughly 500 tonnes per year by the end of 2025. Sells a Made-in-USA range at budget pricing, notable for 5 kg 'Texas Size' spools, and also supplies heated beds and glass build plates.

product_lines.name: ZYLtech PLA (incl. Matte, Silk, Rainbow, CF)
product_lines.notes: The volume line with matte, luster, along-strand rainbow gradient and carbon-filled variants.

product_lines.name: 5 kg 'Texas Size' spools
product_lines.notes: A spool format, not a material: the same chemistries on 5 kg reels. Recorded because it is the brand's main differentiator, but spool size is never a filament variation.

additional_notes: Pricing roughly USD 17-20/kg, unusually cheap for US-extruded filament. The 500 t/yr figure is a company target rather than confirmed output. Build surfaces sold are glass plates and heated beds; the catalog's glass-borosilicate plate is the closest match but the specific product was not verified, so plate_ids is left unset.

provenance.conflicts: The ~500 t/yr capacity is a stated goal for end-2025, not verified output.
